conditions.meaning: first independent carrier reaches distinguished field element D
second independent carrier reaches the same D
A_ψ is non-constant; distinguished fiber is not all carriers

independence_requirements: c₁ and c₂ must be distinct carrier executions
their independence provenance must be recorded
the claim must not rely only on training both carriers to reproduce the same committed atlas output
reader_independence.gate: EXACT only if RI1 ∧ RI2 ∧ RI3 and independence provenance all pass

carrier_A.evidence: parses SVG text into a DOM tree, then reads data-sem-*-b64 attributes via element.attrib

carrier_B.evidence: scans raw SVG text with <g ...> tag and key="value" regexes; no DOM

real_carriers.note: Both carriers decode the same committed data-sem-*-b64 payload fields with base64+json (shared data format, not shared parsing). The parsing strategy (DOM vs raw-text scan) is structurally independent.

optional_stronger_property.name: component-wise sensitivity
optional_stronger_property.predicate: for every declared component k of c, there exist c,c' differing only in k with A_ψ(c) ≠ A_ψ(c')
optional_stronger_property.claim_enabled: adapter uses every declared carrier component nontrivially

independent_reader.implementation_constraint: must not import or call self_read_roundtrip.py, export_concepts.py, or their parsing helpers
independent_reader.strategy: raw-text/regular-expression property scanner; does not reconstruct the full atlas
checks: concept-id order equals committed atlas order
all concept ids satisfy the project identifier syntax
exactly 103 data-equation attributes accompany concept groups
embedded metadata chapter titles equal committed chapter titles
all 103 data-equation attributes contain non-empty equation content
visible Ch14 PNG SHA-256 equals an independent hashlib recomputation of assets/ch14_test_object.png
independent_reader.claim: independent structural + selected semantic property agreement; not full semantic correctness
semantic_guards: independent SHA-256 recomputation of Ch14 PNG via hashlib
all serialized concept equations must be non-empty
